title: Deathstalker Venom
html:
Source not yet observed

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) of one of these uses one:

  • of Corrosion (gems: Onyx + Topaz + Emerald)
  • staff of Acid (gems: Amber + Emerald + Emerald)
  • of the Hedgehog (gems: Diamond + Emerald + Emerald)

Dropped by Scorpion: Dune Scorpion, Rock Scorpion, Deathstalker Scorpion
Sand Wyrm: Sand Wyrmling, Sand Wyrm, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Enchanter’s Table for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.

How to get it

No monster drops recorded for this item.
